name: aws-durable-execution-sdk-js-insight-vscode
description: Query AWS Durable Execution Workflow Insight data from CloudWatch Logs using plain English.

workflowInsight.region.description: AWS region of the CloudWatch log group (e.g. us-east-1). Falls back to AWS_REGION.

workflowInsight.logGroupName.description: CloudWatch log group that receives Workflow Insight records. With the default LambdaLogExporter this is the function's own log group, e.g. /aws/lambda/my-durable-fn. Comma-separate multiple groups.

enumDescriptions: Dedicated log group via CloudWatchLogsExporter — records are raw JSON, fields queryable directly
Function's own log group via LambdaLogExporter — records nested in Lambda JSON envelope (message field)
DynamoDB table via DynamoDBExporter — records queryable via PartiQL
Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL via AuroraExporter — full SQL with GROUP BY, JOIN, aggregations
S3 via S3Exporter — queried through Amazon Athena (Trino/Presto SQL) over a Glue table
Amazon SQS via SQSExporter — live view that listens to the queue as records arrive (no query engine)
workflowInsight.destinationType.description: Where and how records are stored. Determines query engine and format.

workflowInsight.sqsQueueUrl.description: SQS queue URL to listen to (required when destinationType is 'sqs').

workflowInsight.sqsDeleteAfterRead.description: Delete messages from the queue after displaying them in the live view. Off by default so the Explorer only observes — other consumers still receive every message. Enable only if this Explorer should be the sole consumer of the queue.

workflowInsight.dynamodbTableName.description: DynamoDB table name (required when destinationType is 'dynamodb').

workflowInsight.auroraResourceArn.description: Aurora cluster ARN (required when destinationType is 'aurora').

workflowInsight.auroraSecretArn.description: Secrets Manager ARN for Aurora Data API auth (required when destinationType is 'aurora').

workflowInsight.auroraTable.description: Aurora table name containing insight records.

workflowInsight.athenaDatabase.description: Glue/Athena database containing the workflow insight table (required when destinationType is 's3').

workflowInsight.athenaTable.description: Glue table name for records written by S3Exporter.

workflowInsight.athenaWorkgroup.description: Athena workgroup to run queries in. Leave empty to use the 'primary' workgroup and set athenaOutputLocation instead.

workflowInsight.athenaOutputLocation.description: S3 location for Athena query results, e.g. s3://my-bucket/athena-results/. Required unless the chosen workgroup has its own output location configured.

workflowInsight.athenaS3Location.description: S3 location the S3Exporter writes records to, e.g. s3://my-bucket/workflow-insight/. Used to auto-create the Glue table (JSON SerDe, Hive year=/month=/day= partitioning) if it doesn't already exist.

workflowInsight.awsProfile.description: Named AWS profile to use. Leave empty to use the default credential provider chain (env, SSO, default profile).

enumDescriptions: Amazon Bedrock (Converse API) — requires AWS credentials and model access
GitHub Copilot (VS Code Language Model API) — requires Copilot subscription
Local LLM (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B) — runs offline, downloads model on first use (~2.2 GB)
workflowInsight.llmProvider.description: Which LLM to use for converting questions to queries.

workflowInsight.bedrockModelId.description: Amazon Bedrock model id (or inference profile id) used to convert English to a Logs Insights query.

enumDescriptions: Basic — generate one query, run it, and retry only if the query itself errors. Fastest and cheapest.

Advanced (agentic) — after a query runs, the model judges whether the results actually answer your question and refines the query if not, iterating a few times. Slower and uses more model/query calls (billable), best for exploratory questions. Bedrock recommended.
workflowInsight.agenticMode.description: How autonomously the assistant works to answer a question. 'advanced' adds a result-verification loop on top of 'basic'.

workflowInsight.agenticMaxIterations.description: Advanced mode only: the maximum number of run→verify→refine rounds the assistant will attempt for one question before stopping. Higher values let it work harder on difficult questions but cost more model/query calls (billable). The loop also stops early if it starts repeating a query it already tried.

workflowInsight.agenticMaxScannedMB.description: Advanced mode only (Amazon Athena / S3 destination): cumulative Athena data-scanned budget in MB across all queries the assistant runs for one question. When exceeded, the agent stops exploring and returns its best result so far — guards against an autonomous multi-query loop running up Athena scan cost. Ignored for non-Athena destinations.

scripts.build: cd webview-ui && npm run build && cd .. && node esbuild.mjs
